artworks.title: The Lime-Burner
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in black on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior scene with wooden beams and ladders. It presents an architectural space, seemingly the inside of a barn or shed, characterized by wooden structures, beams, and various pieces of equipment, including ladders leaning against the walls. A pathway leads deeper into the structure. The texture and shading provide depth, suggesting the worn, rustic quality of the materials used in the construction of the space. The beams and wooden planks are finely detailed, capturing the natural grain and texture of the wood. The open view lets in ambient light, subtly illuminating the interior.

artworks.title: Billingsgate
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in black on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows an etching of a riverside scene with a wooden barge in the foreground and sailboats docked in the background. People are gathered on the barge, and the riverbank is filled with buildings and crowds of people. The fine lines in the etching depict texture and movement in the water and sails. The color palette is sepia and black, creating a timeless quality. In the distance, arches of a bridge are visible.

artworks.title: Rotherhithe
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in black on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a harbor scene with tall ships and a dockside building. The illustration shows the masts and rigging of large sailing ships against the sky. The composition has vertical and horizontal lines that frame the ships and the waterfront structures. In the foreground, there are figures on the deck near the dock. The image is monochromatic, using lines and hatching to create depth and texture. The style and technique focus on detail, light, and shadow contrast.

artworks.title: Thames Police
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in black on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is an etching showing a lively port or dockside scene. Boats and figures are depicted near the water, with additional boats and buildings in the background. The skyline consists of buildings, including one labeled "Thames Police." The etching employs fine lines to convey textures and details. The color scheme is monochromatic, emphasizing black and gray tones.

artworks.title: The Punt
artworks.medium: photogravure in black on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a man on a boat using a pole to steer. The boat is on a calm body of water, with a wooden edge visible extending to the left. On the horizon, there are trees, structures, and a small building. The artwork is created using fine lines and cross-hatching for texture. The monochrome palette uses varying intensities of black against a light background. Diagonal lines in the sky hint at clouds.

artworks.title: Fulham
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in black on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a river, a bridge across it, buildings, and trees on the far bank. The horizon is high in the image. The bridge and distant structures are depicted with fine lines. The color palette is black and off-white. Small boats near us are depicted with delicate lines.

artworks.title: The Tiny Pool
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in black on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a waterfront scene with boats extending into the distance. The horizon is in the upper third, with numerous sailboat masts visible. The style is an etching with fine lines and cross-hatching creating texture. The color palette is monochromatic with varying shades of black and gray on a light background. Boats are moored close by, with a dock leading into the water, and two distant figures are faintly visible.

artworks.title: The 'Adam and Eve', Old Chelsea
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in black on laid paper
artworks.description: This image shows a riverside town with buildings, boats, and a river. The buildings dominate the composition with their detail and the limited sepia color palette. Boats are moored by the river and there is a person tending to them. Some buildings are labeled with signs like "The Adam and Eve." The scene conveys a nostalgic and tranquil atmosphere.

artworks.title: Hurlingham
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in black on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a riverside scene viewed from a slightly elevated perspective. The horizon line is positioned high in the composition, with trees and buildings visible. The buildings are nestled among the trees with fine brushstrokes, giving intricate details. Closest to us are large dark sails dominating the right side, reflecting in the still water. The color palette is monochromatic sepia, creating a vintage effect and emphasizing light and shadow interplay. The sepia tones enhance the serene mood of the riverside setting.

artworks.title: The Little Lagoon
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in black on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a waterway scene with a clear view across the water towards the horizon. The horizon with a distant strip of land, buildings, and ships is near the top third of the image. The brushstrokes are minimalistic, emphasizing simplicity and fluidity in the lines. The color palette is monochrome, primarily using shades of grey and cream, creating a calm visual impact. Two slender poles are in the water, with small boats and a larger vessel with two masts further away. The sky has a few wispy clouds, enhancing the serene ambiance of the image.

artworks.title: Upright Venice
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in black on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows an elevated view of a busy waterway. The horizon line is high, showing buildings, domes, and a distant landmark. The detailed etching style includes fine lines and cross-hatching for texture and depth. The color scheme is monochromatic, with shades of black and gray. Closest to the viewer, there are people, boats, and activity along the water's edge. Further out, gondolas and watercraft can be seen on the water, leading towards the cityscape and clouds in the sky.

artworks.title: Rag Pickers, Quartier Mouffetard, Paris
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in black on laid paper
artworks.description: The image displays two individuals within a room. The scene is visible through a doorway framed by textured walls. On the left, a woman is seated at a table aligned parallel to the walls. She has long hair, a light long-sleeve top, and is looking towards the standing figure. The person on the right is standing, wearing a dark jacket, trousers, and a hat, obscuring their facial features. The room has a rustic interior with a table holding various objects, textured walls, and a shadowy background. The floor has a wooden texture.

artworks.title: Sunset in Ireland
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in black on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape viewed from a slightly elevated angle, featuring a stream winding through the scene. Trees line the horizon, created using fine lines for texture. The artwork is monochromatic with black and white shades for contrast. The stream curls around grassy edges in the foreground, while dense trees fill the middle ground. The horizon shows a sky and a few birds in flight above the treetops.

artworks.title: Westminster Bridge
artworks.medium: etching, roulette, and softground on japanese paper
artworks.description: The image depicts an urban scene with notable landmarks such as a clock tower in the background. The view is from street level, capturing busy city activity. Historic buildings and the clock tower are visible on the horizon. The artwork appears to be an etching with fine lines and detailed textures. The color palette consists of brown tones, creating a sepia-like effect. The scene includes horse-drawn carriages, pedestrians with umbrellas, and street life in the foreground, while architectural silhouettes shape the distant skyline. The border features additional sketches of maritime scenes, architectural details, and urban life.

artworks.title: Mirror of Illusion
artworks.medium: drypoint with softground etching and roulette in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of the Lasky Charitable Lead Trust, 2004)
artworks.description: The image shows elongated, curving lines and faint silhouettes forming an abstract composition. The figures are reminiscent of human forms, like a line of people moving in synchrony. The abstract piece features blurred lines, indistinct outlines, and shapes resembling waves or flowing fabric, adding to the dynamic movement of the scene.

artworks.title: On the Riva, from Pennell's Window
artworks.medium: etching in black on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a bustling urban scene with individuals holding umbrellas walking in various directions. A grand architectural building with a dome and spires dominates the upper third of the image. The structures stretch across the image, featuring detailed designs. The brushstrokes are fine, creating a soft effect that emphasizes movement. The color palette is limited to black and grey, highlighting contrasts and shadows.

artworks.title: Bay Window, Lyme Hall, Cheshire
artworks.medium: hand-colored lithograph on wove paper mounted to board
artworks.description: This is a painting of an ornate interior with richly decorated walls and a fireplace. The painting depicts a lavish room with highly detailed wooden paneling, intricate carvings, and a large, intricately adorned fireplace. The room is furnished with several high-backed, red velvet chairs and a table covered with a green cloth. In the background, there are large stained glass windows, embellished with crests and vibrant colors, allowing light to permeate the room. A patterned red carpet covers the floor.

artworks.title: In the Wings
artworks.medium: watercolor and black crayon on wove paper, mounted on board
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing upright, facing forward with a dark cloak draped over one arm. He has defined facial features, a moustache, and wears a top hat. The man is dressed in a tuxedo with a bow tie. In the background, a young ballerina wearing a pink tutu with black accents can be seen against a vibrant green background. The setting is a painted indoor environment with plain walls and wooden floors, suggesting an elegant venue or theatre back scene.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Friend
artworks.medium: lithographic crayon on wove paper
artworks.description: The image is a sketch showing the upper body of a person, primarily focusing on the head and shoulders. The person is depicted sitting and looking downwards. Their facial features are sharply defined with prominent eyebrows and a downturned mouth. The person's hair is short and appears slicked back. The clothing is suggested by simple lines, indicating a collared garment. There are no visible jewelry or objects being held. The sketch does not include a detailed background. The signature "RHenri" and the date "Feb 1915" are visible at the bottom of the piece.

artworks.title: Une mine d'or qui dort
artworks.medium: lithograph
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures in conversation outdoors near a windmill. The image shows two characters with exaggerated and cartoonish features. The figure on the left is tall and thin, wearing a high top hat and a long coat. The figure on the right is rounder, wearing a shorter hat, a cape, and has a more animated expression. In the background, a windmill is visible. The drawing includes detailed lines for depth and texture, with a block of text in French underneath the image.

artworks.title: River View of the Royal Arches, Yosemite
artworks.medium: albumen silver print
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, with funds from the bequest of Marva Patterson to the Women's Committee of the Corcoran Gallery of Art, and Gift of Jeffrey Fraenkel and Frish Brandt)
artworks.description: The image shows a natural landscape with towering rock formations in the distance. The horizon is marked by the silhouette of cliffs with various textures. Trees are scattered throughout, with some near us framing the scene. A small body of water reflects parts of the landscape. The color palette is composed of sepia tones emphasizing light and shadow.

artworks.title: Untitled (New York City)
artworks.medium: bromoil print
artworks.description: The image depicts a narrow urban alleyway flanked by tall buildings on both sides. The alley stretches into the distance, with a more illuminated area visible far ahead. The buildings create a tunnel-like effect, guiding the viewer's gaze. The photo has a grainy texture, giving it an atmospheric quality. The sepia tones create a vintage look, emphasizing shadow and light contrast. In the distance, faintly visible structures add depth to the urban environment.

artworks.title: Valley of the Yosemite from Mosquito Camp, No. 22
artworks.medium: albumen silver print
artworks.description: The image displays a tranquil river bordered by trees, extending to distant rugged mountains. The horizon features the mountains reflecting in the calm river running across the scene, with trees framing the view. The style appears photographic, emphasizing fine details and soft contrasts. The color palette is warm and sepia-toned, creating a nostalgic quality. Tree trunks and branches add texture, leading the eye to the meandering river reflecting the mountains and sky.

artworks.title: Cross Streets of New York
artworks.medium: pastel, watercolor, charcoal, and gouache on paperboard
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Margaret M. Hitchcock through a Museum Exchange, 1975)
artworks.description: This painting shows a bustling narrow street. Tall tenements are on either side in shades of red and brown. Fire escapes and clothing hang from the sides of the buildings. The street below is covered in white snow. A couple in coats stands among other passersby, and horse-drawn cart is pulled down the street. In the background, the buildings converge at the end of the long street below an icy blue sky.
